title: Figure 30. LLV1 Simulation Results with B = 1,000 (log-scale line graph)
description: Semi-log line graph titled "LLV1 Random-Attitude Failures through 290 sec" plotting Percent in 5-deg sector (%) against Angle From Flight Path (deg), 0–180. Simulated impacts for no breakup and breakup q-alpha 20,000, 10,000 and 5,000 are shown with theoretical Mode-5 curves for B = 1,000 and A = 1.85, 2.60, 2.70 and 2.75. Captioned "Figure 30. LLV1 Simulation Results with B = 1,000".
